title: Crude Oil Fractional Distillation & Petroleum Derivatives
pedagogical_goal: Visually demonstrate how raw crude oil is thermally separated into specific hydrocarbon fractions (LPG, gasoline, naphtha, kerosene, diesel, fuel oil, bitumen) along a vertical 45-meter fractionating column using boiling point differentials and bubble tray condensation.

conservation_laws: Raoult's Law & Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium: P_i = x_i * P_i_sat
Mass Conservation: Total Feed = Sum(Draw-off fractions) + Bottom residue
Clausius-Clapeyron Vapor Pressure: ln(P) = -Delta_H_vap / (R * T) + C
